paite: Huan ni nga nung in siampu lianpen Ananias ahong tungsuk a, upa kuate hiam toh, amin Tertullas thugen siam khat toh; Paul tung a thubuai gam-ukpa kiang ah agen uhi.
heading: Judate'n Paul Ahekna Uh
english: After five days, the high priest, Ananias, came down with certain elders and an orator, one Tertullus. They informed the governor against Paul.

paite: Paul asapkhiak nung un Tertullas in amah ahek pan a, "Felik hoihpen, nangmah vang a khamuang petpet a ka om ziak un leh na hon kepna ziak a hiai namte a ding a kipuahthakna a-om zel ziak in,
english: When he was called, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, “Seeing that by you we enjoy much peace, and that prosperity is coming to this nation by your foresight,

paite: chik lai peuh in koipeuh ah leng lungkimtak in ka pom gige uhi.
english: we accept it in all ways and in all places, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.

paite: Akoi abang hitaleh, nang a dia chimtakhuai hih ka ut kei hi, na migitna in thu kam khat ahihleh hon ngaihkhiaksak ding in ka hon ngen hi.
english: But that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.

paite: Hiai mihuathuaipi, khovel a Judate tengteng tokbuaipa leh Nazarit mite pawl a amakaipen khat uh ahih ka thei uhi.
english: For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.

paite: Tempul hihbuah leng atum a; huaiziak in ka man uhi.
english: He even tried to profane the temple, and we arrested him.

paite: Ka dan bang ua atung a vaihawm tum zaw hi ung a, himahleh sepaih heutu lianpen Lisias ahong kuan a, thagum suah in ka khut ua kipan alakhia a, atung a thubuai neite na kiang a hong pai ding in thu apia hi.
Nangmah ngei in amah dongtel in ka hekna tengteng uh na theithei ding hi," achi hi.
english: By examining him yourself you may ascertain all these things of which we accuse him.”

paite: Huan Judate'n leng huai thu huchibang ahi, chi in apanpih uhi.
english: The Jews also joined in the attack, affirming that these things were so.

paite: Huan gam-ukpa'n thugen ding a Paul akhutvantak in, hichi in adawng a, "Ama'n nang kum tampi hiai namte vai hawmsakpa na hi chih ka theih ziak in kipaktak in ka siamna thu ka gen ding ahi.
heading: Felix Leh Drusilla Ma A Paul Thugen
english: When the governor had beckoned to him to speak, Paul answered, “Because I know that you have been a judge of this nation for many years, I cheerfully make my defense,

paite: Jerusalem a Pathian be ding a ka hohtouh nung ni sawm-le-nih aval nai kei ding chih na na thei ding hi.
english: seeing that you can verify that it is not more than twelve days since I went up to worship at Jerusalem.

paite: Tempul ah hiam sinagog ah hiam, khua ah leng mi kuahiam ka sel leh mipi ka hanthawn lam amau zong ahon mu kei uh.
english: In the temple they didn’t find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the synagogues or in the city.

paite: Tu'n ah leng ahon hekna thu uh na theih in abul asuikhe thei kei ding uh.
english: Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me.

paite: Himahleh hiai thu na kiang ah ka genkhe ding, Dan leh zawlneite thugelh tengteng gingta in, pawl tuam achihte uh Lampi dan bang in ka pipute uh Pathian ka be zel hi.
english: But this I confess to you, that according to the Way, which they call a sect, so I serve the God of our fathers, believing all things which are according to the law, and which are written in the prophets;

paite: Pathian ah lametna nei in, hiai mite'n leng huai agintak sam uh, midiktatte leh diktatloute thohnawnna a-om ding hi.
english: having hope toward God, which these also themselves look for, that there will be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.

paite: Huchi ahih ziak in Pathian leh mihing tung a hihkhial lou ding in sia-le-pha siangtak nei ding in ka kibawl gige hi.
english: In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.

paite: "Huan kum tampi nung in ka chipihte kiang ah thilpiak ding leh thillat ding hon tawi in ka hong hi.
english: Now after some years, I came to bring gifts for the needy to my nation, and offerings;

paite: Huai thil ka piak lai in, Asia gam a kipan Juda mi khenkhatte'n mipi pang lou leh buaina om lou in, tempul ah kisiangsak in ahon mu uhi.
english: amid which certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, not with a mob, nor with turmoil.

paite: Hiai mite'n ka tung a thubuai nei hi le uh na ma ah hong pai in ahong hek khinta ding uhi.
english: They ought to have been here before you and to make accusation if they had anything against me.

paite: Ahihkeileh hiai mite ngei in vaihawmte ma a ka din lai in, ka hihkhelh bang ahia amuh uh, gen uhen.
english: Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,

paite: Alak ua dingh a, 'Misi thohnawnna thu ah tuni in na ma uah salh in ka om ahi,' ka chih a hiai thu kam khat ziak houh ahih kei ngalleh, chi in adawng hi."
english: unless it is for this one thing that I cried standing among them, ‘Concerning the resurrection of the dead I am being judged before you today!’”

paite: Huan Felik hiai thilte azak a, Lampi thu atheihchet ziak in, "Sepaih heutu lianpen Lisias ahong tunsuk hun chiah na thu uh ka lem ding," chi in akoih tadih hi.
english: But Felix, having more exact knowledge concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, “When Lysias, the commanding officer, comes down, I will decide your case.”

paite: Sepaih zaheutu kiang ah, Paul zalentak leh alawmte amah hong veh leh nek-tak abawlsak utte kham lou a, vensak ding in thu apia hi.
english: He ordered the centurion that Paul should be kept in custody and should have some privileges, and not to forbid any of his friends to serve him or to visit him.

paite: Huan ni bangzah hiam nung in Felik ahong nawn a, azi Drusilla, Juda numei toh, Paul asamsak a, Khrist Jesu ginna thu angaikhia hi.
english: After some days, Felix came with Drusilla his wife, who was a Jewess, and sent for Paul and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus.

paite: Paul in diktatna thu, kidek thu, thukhen vaihawmna hong tung dingte asuipih detdet lai in, Felik in lauhuai asa mahmah a, "Pai nawn phot inla, hunlem ka neih hun chiang in ka hon sam ding," achi hi.
english: As he reasoned about righteousness, self-control, and the judgment to come, Felix was terrified, and answered, “Go your way for this time, and when it is convenient for me, I will summon you.”

paite: Paul in dangka apiak peuh alamen a, huaiziak in asam mun hial a, ahoupih zihzeh hi.
english: Meanwhile, he also hoped that money would be given to him by Paul, that he might release him. Therefore also he sent for him more often and talked with him.

paite: Himahleh kum nih akivei sung in Porsias Festas in Felik mun ahon kheng a; Felik in Judate deihsakna ngah a-ut ziak in, hensa in Paul anuseta hi.
english: But when two years were fulfilled, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus, and desiring to gain favor with the Jews, Felix left Paul in bonds.
